19991.summary: Support MODE on STRING, BOOLEAN and TIMESTAMP inputs. Documented new optional dataType arg (MODE(colName,[reducerType],[dataType])) in functions/aggregation/mode.md.

19990.summary: Return the input's logical type from ANY_VALUE. Added typed ANYVALUE(colName,'dataType') form and inferAnyValueType query option (broker config pinot.broker.query.infer.any.value.type, default false, live via cluster config). Documented in functions/aggregation/anyvalue.md.

20063.summary: Make is_leaf_return_final_result aggregate hint work for aggregations without GROUP BY (previously group-by only). Leaf maps hint to serverReturnFinalResult when no group-by key, serverReturnFinalResultKeyUnpartitioned otherwise. Documented applicability, no-GROUP-BY example, and hybrid-table OFFLINE/REALTIME partition caveat in multi-stage-query/operator-types/aggregate.md.

20060.summary: Preserve wide Parquet INT96 timestamps. Converted mode now decodes INT96 to Pinot TIMESTAMP (preserving instants outside the signed epoch-nanosecond range ~1677-2262, previously silently wrapped); raw mode (extractRawTimeValues=true) keeps LONG epoch nanos and rejects out-of-range values. Also preserves legacy UINT64 signed-bit values and advances both readers after extraction failures. Documented the corrected INT96 type-conversion row in build-with-pinot/ingestion/pinot-input-formats.md.

20002.reason: Internal NPE bug fix in the mutable-segment seal path. MutableSegmentImpl.getSortedDocIdIterationOrderWithSortedColumn previously assumed a sorted column with a dictionary also had an inverted index, which is false when the sorted column is a no-dictionary ingestion-aggregation key (dictionary forced for dictIds, no inverted index) -> NPE at seal, blocking REALTIME segment commit. Fix adds getSortedDocIdsWithDictIdForwardIndex (counting sort by dictId rank) and selects the inverted-index path only when it exists. No new config/API/function/default/documented behavior; restores a previously-crashing combination of two already-documented features (no-dict sorted columns #17965 + no-dict aggregation keys #18955). Only one main source file + one test file. Not docs-relevant.

20009.reason: Internal reliability fix for a flaky-test race. PinotHelixTaskResourceManager.deleteTask (force path, used by DELETE /tables/{name}, DROP TABLE, and DELETE /tasks/task/{name}) could 500 when Helix failed to remove the ZooKeeper job context (/PROPERTYSTORE/TaskRebalancer/<job>, NotEmpty) because the task pipeline was still writing it. Change retries deleteJob on HelixException up to 3 attempts with 1s/2s backoff for both forced and non-forced deletes, rethrowing the last HelixException if all attempts fail; non-HelixException precondition failures still fail immediately. Retry counts and backoff are hardcoded (no new config/API/function/default). No documented user-facing behavior changes: the same delete endpoints behave identically, just tolerating a transient Helix write race. One main source file + one test file. Not docs-relevant.

20069.reason: Internal memory-access refactor for compressed forward-index readers. Adds PinotDataBuffer.readWithByteBuffer(offset,size,IOFunction) in pinot-segment-spi for synchronous scoped buffer consumption; BaseChunkForwardIndexReader and VarByteChunkForwardIndexReaderV4 (shared by V5/V6) use it so replaceable read-ahead windows are not lent out beyond a single read via toDirectByteBuffer() views. Default delegates to the existing view API; callbacks return independently owned decompressed output; callers retaining input views still use toDirectByteBuffer(). No new config/query-option/function/default, and no documented user-facing behavior change (identical read results, just safe buffer scoping). Low-level internal/plugin API only. 2 main source files + 1 SPI file; no docs impact.

20035.reason: Internal correctness fix in the query planner for timestamp-index override rewrites. Timestamp-index hints replace DATETRUNC(...) after aggregations already captured their input expressions, so DISTINCTCOUNT(DATETRUNC('DAY',...)) projected the raw timestamp even when the derived DAY index existed. Fix rewrites once at instance-plan entry (InstancePlanMakerImplV2) before fetch planning, using derived columns common to every selected segment, and removes per-segment rewrites/marker key; partially-indexed segment sets keep the original expression. PR body states explicitly: the DAY index must already be configured and built, and SQL is unchanged. No new config/query-option/function/default and no documented user-facing surface change (verified: no new CONFIG/QueryOptionKey/default strings in pinot-core main diff) — it makes an already-documented timestamp index actually apply to aggregation inputs. 3 main source files (InstancePlanMakerImplV2, QueryContext, QueryContextConverterUtils) + 2 test files. Not docs-relevant.

19988.summary: Support ARRAY_AGG/ARRAYAGG without an explicit data type in both engines. Added ARRAY_AGG(expr), ARRAY_AGG(expr, isDistinct), and ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT expr) forms; data type inferred from the column (element type for MV; JSON->STRING), unsupported inferred/supplied types fail in the broker. Explicit-type form preserved. Documented new signatures and examples in functions/aggregation/arrayagg.md and functions/array/array_agg.md.
